records.statement: Managed binary knowledge parsing: authorized active managed FileAssets support deterministic non-OCR PDF, DOCX body XML and static UTF-8 HTML ingestion. Preserve immutable original bytes, SHA-256, size, media type, source version and a typed serialization profile. Emit exact UTF-16 text ranges with typed PDF page, DOCX paragraph or table cell, and HTML element locations through local chunks, mentions and citation resolution. Enforce bounded input, archive expansion, page, paragraph, element, cell, output and worker-time limits; refuse malformed, ambiguous, unsupported or over-limit input without successful partial parsing. Preserve replay identity and old-version citations, current authorization, withdrawal and text or catalog compatibility. Warn for omitted image and DOCX auxiliary content. No OCR, remote resource fetch or production activation is authorized; native Stage 9 onward and full publication acceptance remain separately qualified.

Versioned binary source projection: extend FR-288 beside historical FR-115 and SDD-063 without changing their provenance. Persist explicit media, profile and encoding in durable admission intent and raw metadata; decode only typed binary transport and hash the original bytes. Parse with pinned PDF.js, parse5, yauzl and saxes in a terminable worker using deterministic parser, library and mapping identity. Validate typed source spans and exact offsets before local lineage, chunk, mention and citation handoffs; reparse creates a new artifact identity while replay and restart resolve retained versions without a latest fallback. Apply 20 MiB input, 500 PDF pages, 100000 DOCX paragraphs, 25000 cells, 100000 HTML elements with depth 256, 2000 ZIP entries, 100 MiB expansion at ratio 20, 20 MiB selected XML, 10 MiB output and 60 second worker bounds. V8 heap limits do not establish a hard RSS or OS isolation guarantee; external service consumers require their own evidence.
